name: filament-animalia-theme-visual
description: Visual regression tests for the Animalia Filament theme.

scripts.visual: docker build -t animalia-visual tests/Browser && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app animalia-visual bash -lc "composer build && php vendor/bin/testbench filament:assets --quiet && npx playwright test"
scripts.visual:update: docker build -t animalia-visual tests/Browser && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app animalia-visual bash -lc "composer build && php vendor/bin/testbench filament:assets --quiet && npx playwright test --update-snapshots=all"
